title: RunnerFailure
description: POST /api/runners/jobs/{jobId}/fail: the runner hands the job back. How the server counts it: shutdown (+pause) > unreachable > retryable > fatal.

reason.description: Shown to the wall's admins; clipped to 1000 characters.

retryable.description: Another try (maybe on another runner) may succeed: costs an attempt. False: the job fails for good.

shutdown.description: The runner is stopping, not the job failing: back to the queue without using an attempt.

checkpointStep.description: With shutdown: the step of the newest checkpoint the runner keeps (it resumes there). A shutdown whose checkpoint did not advance counts against a budget.

unreachable.description: Given up because the server or network stayed out of reach: costs a lost lease, not an attempt.

pause.description: With shutdown: the owner paused the runner mid-job. Free (up to RUNNERS__MAXPAUSES per job), and the runner stays online, paused.
